interpretation.canonicalInput: Exact selected candidate canonical input values; null means no candidate was selected.
interpretation.actions: Exact ordered preparation commands decoded from preparationPlanKey; attack NP execution follows every non-null action list.
interpretation.resource: Starting NP gauge plus ordered resource-mutation trace entries; null means no executable candidate was selected.
interpretation.damage: [npLevel, minimum, average, maximum]; null means no numeric maximum was emitted.
interpretation.rank: One-based current-default NP1 average-damage order, with canonical identity as the deterministic tie-breaker; null means the profile has no numeric row.
interpretation.unsupported: Profile-wide fail-closed result when any policy-relevant program has unresolved semantics and therefore the exact maximum is unknown.
